## Description:  
IGF-1 is a large [peptide](https://platinumresearchcompounds.com/product-category/performance-peptides/)/small protein that consists of 70 amino acids in a single chain with three intramolecular disulfide bridges. These disulfide bridges impart molecular rigidity and resistance to particular proteases.  
It is a next generation compound that promotes one of the most important growth factors in the human body. After growth hormone is produced in the pituitary gland it stimulates the liver to produce this peptide which then goes on to stimulate systematic body growth in almost every different type of cell and tissue in the body.
IGF-1 is a hormone similar in molecular structure to insulin. It plays an important role in childhood growth and continues to have anabolic effects in adults.  
Signaling through the insulin/IGF-1-like receptor pathway is a significant contributor to biological aging in many organisms. It was shown that mutations in the daf-2 gene double the lifespan of the roundworm, C. elegans. This implies that IGF-1 could have anti-aging properties and an impact on longevity.  
Spiked levels of IGF-1 has been shown to drastically [increase muscle growth](https://platinumresearchcompounds.com/a-complete-guide-to-the-sarms-fitness/) as a result of heavy weight training and can enhance the rapid repair of existing muscle fibers as well as the promote the regeneration of new muscle fibers.
## Product FAQ  
### [What is IGF-1 LR3?]()  
IGF-1 LR3 is an adjusted research version of the peptide hormone Insulin-Like Growth Factor. This engineered compound has an increased binding affinity for IGF-1 receptors and reduced bonding with serum proteins. The way it functions varies among several tissue types; in muscle cells, for instance, it heightens sensitivity to insulin action resulting in impeded fat storage.
### [What does IGF-1 LR3 target?]()  
IGF-1 LR3 specifically targets muscle cells and increases their insulin sensitivity. This helps reduce fat storage and increases the subject’s ability to burn fat as energy, aiding in lean muscle mass growth. It is primarily for research and typically investigates bodybuilding and physical fitness-related topics.
